items.title: Paul Shaffer interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, August 24, 2023
items.q: I joined his band, it was a union band.

ctx.x: Oh so it was actually a union —

Yes sir. That’s why I had to join. I guess that’s what sparked me thinking about Ricky Lazar you know. I joined his band, it was a union band. I had to join the union right away. Go down and see Rocky Albertini in the back of his shoe store, and he signed me up and I had to promise him, you know, “Don’t be giving away too many of those appearances in the assemblies. I want to know about them when they ask you to play at the school, I want to be able to okay them or not.” So I had to call Rocky Albertini, yes…
I’m sorry, there’s a nice anecdote about you going to see Nat King Cole in Las Vegas?
